messages.text:
The game started beeping when I find a pair. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Removed the match and win beeps from [use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts). Card activation and the game’s visual and accessible feedback remain in place.

Verification: all 138 unit and static checks passed, along with type checking and the production build. The browser suite passed 77 of 78 checks; an artwork check timed out, then passed when rerun on its own. The sound check passed through a complete game and restart.

The formatting check reported 13 unrelated existing files; the changed file passed formatting.
